objects.taxonomy_description: Stringed instrument with solid or semi-hollow body (no sound hole required). Body shape varies: Stratocaster (double-cutaway, contoured edges), Les Paul (single-cutaway, carved top), Telecaster (single-cutaway, slab body). Body is wood (alder, mahogany, maple) with glossy polyester or nitrocellulose finish in solid colors, sunburst, or natural wood grain. Neck is maple or mahogany with fretted fingerboard (rosewood or maple, 21-24 frets). Pickups (magnetic, 1-3) mounted on body. Control knobs (volume, tone) and pickup selector switch. Bridge is fixed or tremolo. Headstock has 6 tuning pegs. Cable jack on body edge.

objects.taxonomy_description: A portable rectangular container with a handle and hinged lid, designed for carrying personal items.

diagnostic_checkpoints.Overall_Shape: The object exhibits a rigid, box-like structure with defined corners and flat surfaces, distinguishing it from soft bags or sacks.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Closure_Mechanism: A visible hinge runs along one edge connecting the base to a lid, indicating a clamshell opening method rather than a drawstring or zipper-only closure.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Carrying_Apparatus: A sturdy handle is attached to the top or side of the container, differentiating it from stationary storage boxes or chests.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Material_Appearance: The surface appears smooth and structured, typically made of hard plastic, leather, or fabric reinforced with a frame, unlike unstructured textile containers.
